cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've crossed out our lunches like you. A clean calendar. First this, then fewer calls, then you ask for the key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I crossed out today. I'm exhausted; I haven't cancelled every lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, today first. That's what he said before seeing me became another job.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow, then. I'll book our usual restaurant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He chose a restaurant too. Public enough that I couldn't beg. Book the corner, please.
